_about: Oil fields (P31 Q211748) and natural gas fields (P31 Q1349255) in Iran with coordinates, from Wikidata, queried 2026-11-26 from https://query.wikidata.org/sparql. Rows: [QID, label, lon, lat]. Pazanan is typed as both; it is kept as gas only. Wikidata covers only the better-known fields.

query.oil: SELECT ?c ?n ?coord WHERE { ?c wdt:P17 wd:Q794; wdt:P31 wd:Q211748; wdt:P625 ?coord. ?c rdfs:label ?n FILTER(lang(?n)='en') }
query.gas: SELECT ?c ?n ?coord WHERE { ?c wdt:P17 wd:Q794; wdt:P31 wd:Q1349255; wdt:P625 ?coord. ?c rdfs:label ?n FILTER(lang(?n)='en') }

gas: South Pars / North Dome Gas-Condensate field
